definition: my longest-watched instrument falling idle because a cheaper rule holds the line

settled:
I have not been measuring my stress level for a few weeks, because the affordability rule has been enough.

That gauge is my most precise and longest-watched instrument, twenty years of it, and it has gone quiet.

The bottleneck did not vanish. The rule keeps me far enough from the limit that the needle does not move.

So the constraint put the instrument out of service. I run forward off the cost model now rather than sampling what actually happened against a gauge.
